rationale: Enumerated all 6 combinations of 2 locations from {n1, n2, n3, n4}. For each combination, computed the maximum patrol-time reduction per section among selected locations, then calculated annual expected customer-minutes saved as sum of (fault_rate × customers_interrupted × max_gain). The combination {n1, n2} yields the maximum objective value of 1026.8 customer-minutes saved annually.
